name: Dashboard QA Checker
description: Validate dashboard datasets with freshness, completeness, reconciliation, anomaly, and schema drift checks before publish.

operational.approval_boundary: Safe for read-only QA evaluation; require human approval before overriding critical failures.
operational.use_when: Use when a dashboard or BI package needs freshness, completeness, reconciliation, and anomaly checks before publish.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
